# WINGS Security Ltd.

Website: https://wingssecurity.ie
PSA Licence 14161 (static and event guarding). CRO 772757.
Republic of Ireland enquiries. Based in Dublin 15.

## Services
- Static guarding and reception security
- Event security
- Installation, monitoring and door-supervision coordination with specialist providers;
  delivery scope, licensing and responsibilities are confirmed before work starts.

## Technology
WYNTRA is in development. IRIS is a planned remote-guarding initiative.
Neither is presented as a currently available WINGS platform.
